title: A General Protocol for Western Blotting Mammalian Cell Lysates
author: David Dilworth
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pxndpme
materials: Cut membrane and probe with desired antibodies diluted in 5% BSA in PBS-T overnight at 4oC.
Incubate membranes in secondary LiCor antibodies to mouse and/or rabbit (diluted - 1:5000) in Licor Odyssey Blocking buffer (927-40000) diluted 1 in 5 in PBS-T.

steps.title: Harvest and wash cells
steps.instruction: Collect cells, wash, and pellet them before lysis.

substeps.instruction: For adherent cells: rinse with 1 × PBS, add 0.25 % trypsin, incubate until detached, add an equal volume of complete media, and transfer to a micro‑fuge tube.
For suspension cells: transfer culture directly to a micro‑fuge tube.
Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 1 × PBS, centrifuge again at 500 × g for 5 min, and remove supernatant.

steps.title: Lyse cells in buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend cell pellet in lysis buffer, add inhibitors, incubate on ice, then add SDS.

substeps.instruction: Add 50–100 µL lysis buffer (20 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8, 150 mM NaCl, 10 mM MgCl₂, 1 mM EDTA, 0.5 % Triton X‑100) to the pellet.
Add fresh protease inhibitor cocktail (100×) and benzoase (10 000×) just before lysis.
Add SDS to a final concentration of 1 %.

steps.title: Determine protein concentration
steps.instruction: Measure protein amount with a BCA assay (Pierce BCA Protein Assay Kit, Cat# 23225) and normalize samples.

steps.title: Prepare samples for electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Add SDS loading buffer to 1×, then boil samples for 5 min.

steps.title: Run SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Load 50–100 µg protein per lane and electrophorese.

substeps.instruction: Use a NuPAGE 4–12 % Bis‑Tris gel (NP0322BOX) with 1× MOPS running buffer.
Run at 100 V for ~2 h, or until the dye front exits the gel.

steps.title: Transfer proteins to membrane
steps.instruction: Transfer proteins onto a 0.2 µm PVDF membrane using a wet transfer.

substeps.instruction: Pre‑soak the PVDF membrane in 100 % methanol, then equilibrate in transfer buffer.
Transfer in 1× Tris‑Glycine transfer buffer at 80 V for 1.5 h.

steps.title: Block membrane
steps.instruction: Incubate membrane in 5 % milk in PBS‑T for 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash membrane
steps.instruction: Wash membrane three times with PBS‑T, 10 min each wash.

steps.title: Image blot
steps.instruction: Capture the blot using a Licor Odyssey CLx imaging system.
